# Instagram API Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-api-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-api-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.1.673**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape and download Instagram posts, profiles, places, hashtags, photos without login. Supports search keywords and URL lists. Download your data as HTML table, JSON, CSV, Excel, XML, and RSS feed.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.0023, Actor start $0.001, Search result $0.006, Add-on: Date filter $0.0013 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-api-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-api-scraper@0.1.673#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `directUrls` | string[] |  |  | Instagram URLs you want to scrape — Add one or more Instagram URLs to scrape. The field is optional, but you need to either use this field or search query below. |
| `resultsType` | string |  | `"posts"` | What do you want to scrape from each page? — You can choose to get posts, comments or details from Instagram URLs. Comments can only be scraped from post URLs. ❗Please note that the stories type has been deprecated. It used to return reels data, which wasn’t aligned with its purpose. Please use reel |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Max results per URL — How many posts or comments (max 50 comments per post) you want to scrape from each Instagram URL. If you set this to 1, you will get a single post from each page. |
| `onlyPostsNewerThan` | string |  |  | Newer than — Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. All time values are taken in UTC timezone |
| `search` | string |  |  | Search query — Provide a search query which will be used to search Instagram for profiles, hashtags or places. |
| `searchType` | string |  | `"hashtag"` | Search type — What type of pages to search for (you can look for hashtags, profiles or places). |
| `searchLimit` | integer |  |  | Search results limit — How many search results (hashtags, users or places) should be returned. |
| `addParentData` | boolean |  | `false` | Add metadata — Only for feed items - add data source to results, i.e. for profile posts metadata is profile, for tag posts metadata is hashtag |
